summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of interest on capital distributions. The second tranche of IOC 2025 will be paid on July 6, 2026, at R$0.0755 per share (gross), with record dates of December 18 and 22, 2025. A new IOC 2026 of R$0.0449 per share (gross) was also declared, payable by December 31, 2026, with record dates of June 22 and 24, 2026. These are routine capital returns to shareholders, not a tender offer or special dividend. The filing is a foreign private issuer report; the US equivalent is an 8-K for material definitive agreements or other events. No advisors or board recommendations are named. What to watch: future board meetings for the exact payment date of IOC 2026.
